if: the document is a payment voucher referred to in clause (g) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 52 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the payment voucher MUST carry the amount of tax payable on the goods or services, by head
note: One mandatory particular of rule 52(h), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: amount of tax payable in respect of taxable goods or services (central tax, State tax, integrated tax, Union territory tax or cess);
